title: Stage 1 Decision Policies
description: Machine-readable gate thresholds, resolution contracts, and verdict rules for Stage 1 validation (v1 legacy baseline and v2 SMB reassessment).

v1.name: Stage 1 Baseline Policy
v1.description: Historical Stage 1 gate thresholds and verdict rules.

G1.name: Concrete pain
G1.description: At least 20 independent VERIFIED concrete pain signals.

G2.name: Recurrence
G2.description: At least MEDIUM confidence that core job recurs often enough for a SaaS relationship.

G3.name: Existing spend / WTP
G3.description: At least 5 independent VERIFIED money signals across at least 2 distinct categories.

G4.name: Repeatable gap in existing solutions
G4.description: At least 10 independent VERIFIED gap signals clustered around repeatable problems.

G6.name: No killer substitute
G6.description: No low-friction sufficient substitute that defeats planned value proposition.

v2.name: Stage 1 SMB Reassessment Policy
v2.description: Admission policy for SMB product hypotheses to prospect mining and customer discovery interviews (<= 8 interviews). Not MVP approval.

G1.name: Concrete pain
G1.description: At least 5 independent VERIFIED examples of experienced concrete pain/workarounds for assessed scope.

G2.name: Recurrence
G2.description: At least MEDIUM confidence in recurrence of core job from observed frequency.

G3.name: Existing spend / WTP
G3.description: At least 3 independent VERIFIED examples of actual target-job spending or actually performed costly work. One category is sufficient; report full breakdown. Stated WTP excluded from threshold.

G4.name: Repeatable gap in existing solutions
G4.description: At least 3 independent VERIFIED examples supporting one coherent, repeated gap/workaround rather than 3 unrelated complaints. Report clusters and member IDs.

G5.name: ICP reachability
G5.description: At least MEDIUM confidence that relevant buyers can be found through a concrete acquisition surface.

G6.name: No killer substitute
G6.description: No evidenced sufficient substitute defeating value proposition for assessed scope. Unresolved substitute fit remains UNKNOWN.
